svg.aria-label: Holding a million connections on one server: each idle connection costs a file descriptor and a few kilobytes of kernel and application buffers, not a thread; raise file descriptor limits, use epoll, keep per-connection state small, and send heartbeats.
svg.title: Holding a million connections on one server: each idle connection costs a file descriptor and a few kilobytes of kernel and application buffers, not a thread; raise file descriptor limits, use epoll, keep per-connection state small, and send heartbeats.
svg.text: and few are active at once
